mentions.name: ISO Hoops
mentions.description: A 3D pixel-art basketball game built with JavaScript. It offers five game modes (free shooting, 10 free throws, HORSE, beat the clock, and 3-point contest) across five courts with dynamic day/night cycles, and runs fully offline with no backend.
